author: /root/native_fix_review
scope: Copy-only NativeReadinessLaunch.swift.in path observer; no app/platform production sources or protocol/state changes. New controls remain in campaign draft until root releases Android3 source freeze.
policy: Same POSIX canonical representation as Python literals
Trusted roots must be existing and unchanged by realpath
Unavailable noncandidate dyld and loader paths are skipped/redacted, never mislabeled as app
Unknown/sibling/escaped/invalid relative paths fail before content callback
Original03 exact rejected path unavailable; do not claim causal proof from source correction alone

authoritative_reference.applicability: POSIX realpath resolves links, extra separators and dot components to an absolute name; all components must exist; requires caller-owned PATH_MAX output buffer, as used here. Native test must verify selected modern SDK behavior; not relying on NULL-allocation extension.

limitations: No Swift compile or native probe run by author
Host Foundation fixtures cannot establish iOS runtime launch or app-storage health

Path classification and subsequent file open are not one atomic filesystem transaction; this patch does not claim protection against an adversary concurrently swapping task-owned directories after validation. Existing post-runtime host hash/path binding stays mandatory.
Root controls Android3 lane and release of source freeze; only campaign drafts created since freeze
